declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration on behalf of Hargrove Lane LLP in support of preliminary approval. The parties negotiated over four rounds. Class relief and attorneys’ fees were discussed together from the first round, not in separate phases. We initially proposed a $35 million class fund and $7 million in separately paid, court-approved fees and expenses. Brightline countered with a $30 million fund and $6 million in fees and expenses. After further proposals of $33 million, $31 million, and $32 million for the class fund, Brightline offered a $31.5 million fund with $6 million in separately paid fees and expenses, which we accepted. Throughout, the parties agreed that payments would be automatic, Brightline would not receive unclaimed funds through a claims process, there would be no clear-sailing provision, and any fees the court declines to award would benefit the class rather than revert to Brightline. The fee remains subject to the court’s independent approval. The complete negotiation transcript will be filed with the preliminary-approval motion.
